Include material unsuccessful or reverted work only when it actually influenced the result. Do not manufacture a reassessment merely because implementation differed. In Implementation Result, capture the actual final repository approach, requirement coverage, constraints, compatibility or regression implications, actual self-validation, unresolved or unverified coverage, and partial, blocked, failed, inconclusive, or no-change state when applicable. In Cycle Intent vs. Implementation, capture material deviations, causal evidence, materially attempted or reverted approaches, material assumption changes, the resulting strategy, and why it was selected when those events occurred. The harness renders observable action chronology from retained events; explain material decisions and reassessment yourself. Self-validation is not authoritative deterministic validation. You may add clearly named, decision-relevant sections after all required sections.
Required sections:

If no solution or only a partial solution was implemented, state that explicitly and identify what remains unresolved or unverified.

If yes, what changed, what evidence or findings discovered during implementation led to the material reassessment, and why was the resulting strategy or solution selected? If there was no material change from the Cycle Intent, state that directly.
